narrative: MDP Coffee House began in 2005 with a single kiosk inside Accenture's Vikhroli campus.
What started as a small operation grew through consistency, disciplined execution, and long-term client relationships.
Today, MDP serves workplaces, tech parks, cafeterias, restaurants, and campuses across India — maintaining the same standards that built the first kiosk.
mission: To deliver dependable food and beverage experiences through disciplined operations, consistent quality, and long-term partnerships.
vision: To become India's most trusted workplace food services company.

principles.title: Craft
principles.body: Respect for food, process, and people.
